objective: If every named product has a factor in a supplied original affine span modulo constants of rank r, construct an unnamed degree-two multiset proof in at most 2^r cases, with polynomial node overhead independent of the number of declarations except through the supplied proof.
status: Proved: A supplied rank-r span containing one original factor, up to constants, at every declaration eliminates arbitrary-depth product names in at most 2^r cases and O(2^r(n+r+1)(S+1)) unnamed quadratic proof nodes.
title: Branch on a basis of original affine factors
